notes.title: Big Bugfix Update is Here!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Huge thanks to all of you who supported [i]Lord Ambermaze[/i] at launch, shared your comments and reviews, and reported bugs. Thanks to you, we’ve got more work to do — and we’ve prepared our very first big bugfix update.[/p][p][/p][p]Update the game, play, and don’t forget to leave a review if you haven’t yet![/p][p][/p][p][b]Here’s what we fixed:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Bug where the Mushroom Minion during the Lava Kraken boss fight stopped reacting to sword hits and didn’t spawn lava tiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where buying Fried Chicken at Blu’s shop didn’t restore HP.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where the game froze when a mob appeared during the Robo-Beetle boss fight.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where the bottom border of some rooms was cut off on the minimap.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where controls froze during the Lord boss fight when stone walls reappeared.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where using the “Piercing Shot” perk on spiked balls caused the game to freeze.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where certain modifier statues became inactive too early.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where Robo-Beetle’s minions didn’t disappear after his death.[/p][/*][*][p]Bug where a Robo-Beetle minion could become invulnerable if a stalactite fell on it.
Bug where the Rufa statue granting +2 to shots didn’t work.
Bug that prevented players from receiving the final achievements![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed blocker when buying mana from Blu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple texture bugs.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Text and localization fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed incorrect intro credits starting in the wrong languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect description of the Vampirism Potion in English.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect description of Zeus’s Ring in French.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect description of the Wind Gust Potion in German.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed broken dialogues with Diggeria.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed numerous typos in cutscenes and dialogues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed numerous typos in Rufa’s statue and artifact descriptions.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay improvements:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reworked the final boss and his wave patterns.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the logic in trials where you must attack only with a sword — using the shield is no longer counted as a failure, since it’s defensive, not offensive.
[/p][/*][/list][p]And one more thing: Rufa has lost her levitation powers and no longer floats in the middle of a chasm in some of the colored puzzle rooms.[/p][p][/p][p]With love,
 The Lord Ambermaze Team[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Bugs, Love, and Shell Games: What’s New in Lord Ambermaze
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

You’ve already taken a peek at our mysterious new acid biome — now it’s time to meet the creature that calls it home. And no, it’s not a cuddly slime...

Introducing: [b]the Robo-Bug [/b]— a terrifying fusion of metal, darkness, and the twisted experiments of the Dark Lord.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Ngkcd39B/Lord-3.gif[/img]

Half machine, half... yep, you guessed it — beetle. A hulking monstrosity with lasers tucked under its shell, ready to test your reflexes (and patience). Don’t worry — dying is almost fun!

But that’s not all — we’ve packed in a bunch of new mini-games to makeZeyn’s adventure even more exciting.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/KckDFkCt/LA-chests.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Feel lucky? Try your hand at the classic shell game and see if you can score some treasure.
[*] Can you escape a pitch-black room with nothing but your instincts?
[*] Solve color puzzles or push some crates around in a good old-fashioned [b]sokoban[/b] challenge!
[/list]
After all, you can’t only dodge spikes and fall into pits, right?

[img]https://i.ibb.co/KzyN42Kx/LA-love.gif[/img]

And yes — [b]romance[/b] is in the air!
We’ve added a touch of love to our chaotic world: characters now have charming gift-receiving animations and adorable little hearts floating above their heads. Because even in the darkest dungeons, everyone deserves a little warmth.

Which update caught your eye the most? Let us know in the comments — and don’t forget to add Lord Ambermaze to your Wishlist!
It’s crucial for our survival... as a project, of course. 😅

With love and lasers,
The Lord Ambermaze Team

notes.title: The Ice Girl, the Digger, and the Loner Witch—More Sad Captives of the Island
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We continue to introduce you to the heroes of the world of Lord Ambermaze. If you missed the first part, you can find it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1811330/announcements/detail/517453005451166608?snr=2___]here[/url]. Don’t forget to refresh your memory, because there’s an important question waiting for you at the end of this post!

For now, let us introduce you to the next trio of heroes.

[h3][b]Dee[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/44e89108e7ffd2206cf3ba6d5e2d8d7c577d543f.png[/img]
The Charming Digger. In her past life, her only close companions were her crew. But on the island, Di found herself alone—her team has vanished. In her endless search for her friends, she is driven to madness by the longing and loneliness in the dark dungeons of the Lord.

[h3][b]Ninelle[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/33b3bcba92f29e43eac5df861792330de2cc8168.png[/img]
Before arriving on the island, she faced hatred and malice from those around her. Unable to cope, she became bitter and began to treat others the same way. But somewhere deep in her heart, love still resides. Perhaps you could reach out to her?

[h3][b]Icy[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/cf52d15ef929fc58fb7dca066cc71b38218cf5b9.png[/img]
In the outside world, she was cold and indifferent to the feelings of others. She cared for no one but herself. It’s no wonder that on this mystical island, she faces a harsh trial: she constantly feels cold. Even in the lava's heat, she shivers from the chill of her soul. A little compassion and love might help her. Probably.

And now for the question: Which of our game’s heroes do you feel a connection with? Who would you take out on a date for Valentine’s Day?

Best regards,  
The Lord Ambermaze Team

notes.title: Meet the Inhabitants of the Mysterious Island
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’d like to share a bit about the characters of the Lord Ambermaze, whom our brave hero encounters in various corners of the labyrinth. Just like Zeyn, they all accidentally found themselves on the island and have been its captives for many years. Each of them has their own story, motives, and unique traits.

[h3][b]Varion  [/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/00b86c960b73ba62395e7be1d39a28d860635fd8.png[/img]
In her past life, she was a hero and a respected citizen of his city. But fame blinded her; the sun of her vanity began to shine brighter than the sun of her heart. Money and popularity are now her main values and the meaning of her life. Is there still a place in her heart for something more?

[h3][b]Blu[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/dcb03265429e1accb9391abe82ca4472d2caa05a.png[/img]
Charming and talented, but she only uses her talents for personal gain—sometimes at the expense of others. Before arriving on the island, she was determined to get rich at any cost, even resorting to fraudulent actions.

[h3][b]Rufa[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/01f50d8bd3f6d6551c0aeb1049bc007c3727e804.png[/img]
She was the most famous sculptor in her city, creating statues of astonishing beauty. However, by dedicating herself entirely to her art, she forgot everything else and ultimately lost it all. On the strange island of Lord Ambermaze, one cannot age or die physically, but it’s all too easy to grow old in spirit…

In our upcoming posts, we’ll introduce you to more inhabitants of the island, as well as new mechanics we’ve devised. Be sure to add Lord Ambermaze to your Wishlist, follow the game’s page, and join our [url=https://discord.gg/ZhjKSKRFrh]Discord[/url]!

Regards,  
The Lord Ambermaze Team

notes.title: Play Lord Ambermaze’s Free Prologue and Win the Full Game!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The free prologue of Lord Ambermaze will be released on November 21. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2070580/Lord_Ambermaze_Prologue/

Lord Ambermaze is a turn-based adventure game with the feel of classic Zelda games. It’s an exciting mix of puzzles, deadly traps, mysterious mazes, turn-based combat, and an intriguing story!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41479895/9a60ad0914e4a06798af3ad2dae10c4b90b00866.png[/img]

In the free version, you’ll find:
[list]
[*] A unique, standalone story that precedes the full game
[*] An exclusive boss not included in the full game
[*] Over thirty unique one-screen challenges filled with enemies, traps, and puzzles
[*] Speedrunning mode to test your skills and compare your results with players worldwide on the global leaderboard
[/list]
Speaking of which, we’re announcing…
 
[h3][b]The Speedrunner Contest![/b][/h3]

[b]What do you need to do?[/b]

Navigate the mysterious maze as quickly as possible. Your score will appear on the in-game leaderboard.

[b]We’ll collect data until 23:59 Central European Time on December 20.[/b] 
The top 10 players with the best times will win a prize—[b]a key to the full version of the game![/b]

Subscribe to the prologue page, and don’t forget to add the main game to your wishlist!

Regards,
Lord Ambermaze Team

notes.title: Play the first demo of Lord Ambermaze!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

Our game will be a part of this year's PAX East event, taking place March 21–24 in Boston! In honor of this event, we are unveiling the first big playable demo for Lord Ambermaze.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/WyJ6Bs6/image.gif[/img]

A fateful accident brings Zin and his sister Shantee to a strange island ruled by the mysterious Lord Ambermaze. For what purpose has he captured Shantee? How can she be freed? Can you even trust the creatures who not only live here but are willing to help you? All this and more await you in the demo! 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/bRfpZRH/image.gif[/img]

The demo will include: 
[list]
[*] Tutorial and the first biome of the game;
[*] Six enemies and one boss;
[*] Upgrades and abilities for your hero;
[*] Many rooms with secrets and hiding places.
[/list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/p1tPSDc/image.gif[/img]
Experience an atmospheric adventure in the spirit of the classic Legend of Zelda games! Play, stream, and share your impressions of the game here or on [url=https://discord.gg/M83fnAbgWT]Discord[/url].


Regards,
Lord Ambermaze Team
